title: SPF record missing
description: No SPF record published; sender spoofing is easier
remediation: Publish an SPF record that ends in -all

title: MTA-STS not deployed
description: No MTA-STS policy; inbound-mail TLS can be stripped (downgrade)
remediation: Publish an MTA-STS policy and _mta-sts TXT record

title: DNSSEC not enabled
description: Zone is not DNSSEC-signed; DNS answers can be spoofed/tampered
remediation: Enable DNSSEC signing at the registrar/DNS provider
